ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon 90 days' written notice to HDI; for this purpose, Customer means the Company.

ops.oldText: the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two, but not exceeding 3 months' fees.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an express right for Customer (the Company) to terminate for convenience mid-term on 90 days' written notice, and capped the Termination Payment at 3 months' fees. That is our fallback position; as drafted the formula (half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000) is an uncapped exit penalty that grows without limit.
proposal.summary: Add a Customer convenience termination right on 90 days' notice and cap the Termination Payment at 3 months' fees.

mappings.element: Early-termination fee not exceeding 3 months' fees.
Vendor termination for convenience only at the end of a term.
mappings.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
